text:
nina: quick thread for VegaTech POC. They want a 10-day pilot: streaming SDK (node + python), function/tool-calls to their product API, strict structured JSON output, SAML SSO, and customer KMS (cloud preferred). They asked for a monthly ballpark for ~300 sustained QPS. Any blockers? :wave:

sam: doable. Recommend Dedicated for sustained 300 QPS to hit p99 latency with streaming + external calls. Main risks: external tool latency & SAML metadata delays.

kevin: for structured output we suggest function-calling + json-schema enforcement. Example starter schema:
{
  "type":"object",
  "properties":{"request_id":{"type":"string"},"results":{"type":"array"}},
  "required":["request_id"]
}

kevin: node quickstart:
const {StreamClient} = require('@redwood/sdk')
const c = new StreamClient(process.env.RW_TOKEN)
c.stream({model:'redwood-chat-1'}).on('data', d => console.log(d))

marta: security notes: SOC2 ok. Cloud KMS fastest; on-prem KMS needs legal addendum. For SAML we need IdP metadata (entityID, ACS URL, x509 cert). SAML enablement in Private ~3 business days after metadata.

sam: pricing ballpark: if median output ~60 tokens, estimate ~25-40k/mo committed for Dedicated before discounts. Hosted pilot possible but may not meet p99 SLOs.

nina: fallback if KMS/SAML delayed?

marta: fallbacks: 1) Use hosted with cloud-KMS + ephemeral STS creds for POC. 2) Use sanitized/stubbed product API for validation. 3) Defer SAML to post-POC. All acceptable to security with documented controls.

kevin: I'll prepare a small Node adapter for tool_call with a 1.5s timeout and partial placeholder behavior. Sam will draft runbook + capacity calc. Marta adds security checklist.

nina: action items: kevin adapter (today), sam runbook & pricing (EOD), marta security checklist (EOD). I'll send to buyer and schedule kickoff. deploy-bot: created doc "vega-poc-runbook-draft" in sales/gdrive (shared).

nina: thanks everyone.
